operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Israeli Strikes Kill Five in Gaza, Including Two Children — Kushner Says Israel Acting 'A Little Irrational' Over Election
heroSubtitle: On Day 1062 (Sep 7, 2026), Israeli strikes killed five Palestinians across Gaza in 24 hours despite the ceasefire: a drone strike killed Mohammad Sukkar (28) in Rimal, Gaza City; a vehicle strike killed Yousef Aqila and his 7-year-old daughter Wafaa as they returned from buying school supplies; an artillery strike on the Sakina School shelter in Deir al-Balah killed 7-year-old Saadi Ghalia; and Hassan Ali Saqallah (19) was also killed in Gaza City, with 17 more wounded strip-wide. The IDF separately disclosed killing a Palestinian Islamic Jihad operative in Gaza City's Shati camp on Sep 6 and a Hamas Nukhba member in a prior strike, alongside a rare disclosure that it diverted a munition mid-air to avoid civilians. US envoy Jared Kushner, in Kyiv, said Israel's government is acting 'a little irrational' on Gaza because of next month's election — a rare public rebuke of Netanyahu by a senior Trump official. Gaza's Health Ministry put the cumulative toll at 73,658+ killed since Oct 7, 2023, and the ceasefire-period toll at 1,352 killed, 4,511 wounded. On Day 1061 (Sep 6), an Israeli strike killed two, including a girl, in Al-Nasr, Gaza City; Gaza City held a mass funeral for 100 people, including 60 children, recovered from Zeitoun rubble; eight Muslim-majority nations warned of 'grave consequences' over Defense Minister Katz's and National Security Minister Ben Gvir's Gaza-displacement proposals; and Netanyahu said he 'attacked Qatar' while defending Qatari aid-fund transfers to Gaza. On Day 1060 (Sep 5), rescue teams recovered the remains of 55 Malka family members from Zeitoun rubble and a new Freedom Flotilla mission set sail toward Gaza. On Day 1059 (Sep 4), the US State Department publicly rejected Israeli displacement plans, citing Trump's peace-plan guarantee against forced departure. On Day 1058 (Sep 3), an Israeli drone strike on Rimal killed a 13-year-old, the IDF shot dead two Palestinians crossing the Yellow Line near Beit Lahia, and Ben Gvir unveiled 'Disengagement 710,' a plan to remove 1.86 million Palestinians from Gaza over seven years.
